description: {{app}} is an inventory management application for small businesses: track products and stock levels, manage suppliers and customers, and settle purchases and sales through the invoice lifecycle. This demo runs against the live Spring Boot API.

hero.headline: Know what's in stock - and what it earns.

demo.resetNotice: Demo data - resets Mondays at 03:00 UTC

screenshots.title: A look inside
screenshots.dashboard: Dashboard with key figures and charts

features.title: What's inside
features.subtitle: Six building blocks designed as one coherent domain, not a loose set of CRUD screens.

inventory.title: Products and stock
inventory.text: Master data with operator-assigned SKUs; stock enters only through closed purchase invoices, never by hand.

invoices.title: Invoice lifecycle
invoices.text: Purchases and sales with returns, payment tracking and operator-assigned invoice numbers.

profit.title: Honest profit
profit.text: Gross profit charges only the goods actually sold - cost is captured at the moment of sale and survives price changes.

cashflow.title: Cash flow over time
cashflow.text: Money counts when invoices are paid: inflow, outflow and net, overall and per product.

audit.title: Complete history
audit.text: Every price change and stock movement is recorded with its actor - and readable as a report.

i18n.title: German and English, light and dark
i18n.text: The entire interface ships in both languages and both themes - this page included.

one.title: Open the demo
one.text: One click as admin or user - seeded data, reset weekly.

two.title: Run stock through invoices
two.text: Create products, book purchases and sales, record losses with a reason.

three.title: Read the numbers
three.text: Seven reports turn the ledger into profit, cash flow, stock history and an audit trail.

tech.title: Built like production software
tech.text: Spring Boot on Java 21 with a Spring Modulith architecture, PostgreSQL with a Flyway-owned schema, and Angular with Material 3. Every change ships through CI with the full test suite, and the architecture is documented in arc42 with a decision record behind every trade-off.

cta.title: See it with real data
cta.text: The demo runs against the live API and resets every Monday - nothing you click is permanent.
